answer: A Gym membership tenure with club attestation proves a body showed up: a membership held continuously for five years. The club photographs the member, logs every visit, and renews only in person, so a farm needs a hundred photographed faces and a hundred $45 a month for five years memberships. The forge is the check-in trail: accounts with no visits are worthless. What makes the jetty expensive is renewal, year after year, and the atlas is the photo match: one face cannot hold a hundred cards.
